description.value: Barnabas Landing is a Christian retreat centre founded in 1986, situated on the north side of Keats Island off BC's Sunshine Coast and operated by Barnabas Family Ministries. The property hosts curated year-round retreats for families and leaders, as well as group bookings for non-profit, ministry, and corporate organizations ranging from 20 to 80 guests. Reaching the centre requires a boat or ferry crossing from the Gibsons/Langdale area, making it an unusual but scenic island destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Barnabas Landing is an active Christian retreat centre on Keats Island, operated by Barnabas Family Ministries since 1986. Phone number on the website (+1 778 200-3553) matches the OSM tag (+17782003553). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields default to null. The physical location is on Keats Island, accessible only by boat/ferry from the Sunshine Coast, which is a meaningful concern for road-cycling tourists.
concerns: Physical location is on Keats Island, accessible only by boat or ferry — not reachable by road cycling from the mainland or Vancouver Island.
Primarily a group/retreat booking model; it is unclear whether individual touring cyclists can book a stay without joining an organized retreat.
OSM address field is empty; mailing address (PO Box 309 Gibsons) is a mainland postal address and does not reflect the island physical location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable retreat centre with a confirmed web presence and current contact details. Island-only access is unusual for a cycling directory but is not grounds for exclusion.
